text: Sketching the bridge for the engineering class. Pier1 and Pier2 hold up the Deck. Deck should be above both piers. Connect Cable to Deck and Cable to Pier1. Make Cable brown. Is there a path from Pier2 to Cable? Which shape is the topmost?
Make Bolt1 gold. Is Bolt1 huge?

Setting up quiz night at the pub. Host sits at the front, so put it at the top. TeamRed sits left of Host and TeamBlue sits right of Host. Make TeamRed red and make TeamBlue blue. Connect Host to TeamRed and Host to TeamBlue with a dashed line. Is TeamRed near TeamBlue? Show the list of red shapes. Duplicate TeamBlue once for a third team.

Basket holds everything, so connect Basket to Milk, Eggs and Bread2. Milk is a small white square. Make Eggs yellow. What is the degree of Basket? Put Bread2 next to Eggs. Describe the list for the family.
Queue feeds Teller, and Teller opens the Vault. Make Vault red. Is Vault reachable from Queue? Which shape is the least connected? Undo the last connect.
Rook is a big brown square. Knight should be right of Rook. Bishop is left of Rook. Make Queen gold. Is there any circle? Show me all the squares. Count the shapes.
Red is red. Orange is orange. Yellow is yellow. Green is green. Blue is blue. How many shapes are not blue?

We're sketching the ward layout for the nursing handbook. Desk is in the center of the room, and Nurse sits at it. Bed1, Bed2 and Bed3 should line up in a row, so arrange them in a row. Door is at the far left, so put it at the left. Connect Desk to Bed1, Bed2 and Bed3 so the nurses can see each bed. Make Bed1 blue and make Bed3 green. Is Door reachable from Bed1? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the ward for the handbook. Rename Desk to Station. Duplicate Bed2 once because the ward is getting bigger. Count the arrows on the map. Show me all the blue shapes. Undo the last arrange if the beds look wrong. Thanks, the nurses review it on Thursday.
Top goes on the Filling, and the Filling sits on the Base. Make Filling red. Is there a cycle? Which shape has the fewest connections?
Put everyone in a circle for the dinner party. Anna is next to Ben. Make Cara green. Dan should be right of Cara. Is Anna near Dan? Which shape is the closest to Ben? Describe the seating.

The robot arm goes from Base2 to Arm, then to Claw. Sensor2 watches the Claw, so connect Sensor2 to Claw with a dotted line. Make Claw orange. Is Sensor2 directly linked to Base2? Describe the robot for the lab notes. Undo the last connect.
Delete Sensor2.

Fence goes around the whole park. Bench should be above Fountain. Gate2 sits at the bottom. Make Fountain blue. Is Bench near Gate2? What is the degree of Fence? Duplicate Bench once for the other side.
Connect New to Crescent, Crescent to Half, Half to Full, and Full back to New. Is there a cycle? Make Full yellow. Count the arrows. Label New as Start. Which shape is the closest to Half?

We're designing the layout of our new cafe and the builder needs a clear diagram by Monday. Counter sits near the Kitchen, so put Counter left of Kitchen. Table1, Table2 and Table3 go in a row by the window. Door is at the bottom, so move Door below Counter. Connect Door to Table1 and Table1 to Counter, so customers flow in one direction. Make Kitchen gray and make Counter brown. Is Table3 reachable from Door? Which shape is the farthest from Door? Describe the cafe for the builder. Duplicate Table2 twice for the terrace. Rename Kitchen to Back. Count the shapes in the plan. Show me all the brown shapes. Undo the last connect if the flow looks wrong. Thanks, the builder is waiting on this.
Streak unlocks Badge2, and Badge2 unlocks Reward. Make Reward gold. Is Reward reachable from Streak? Describe the badges. Rename Badge2 to Medal.
Magma rises through the Vent. Crater sits above Vent. Make Ash gray. Is Ash connected to Magma? Show me the list of shapes left of Crater. Move Magma below Vent.
From now on triangles are green. Make Fish a small blue circle. Is there any green shape? Hamster should be left of Fish. Connect Parrot to Fish with an arrow. Forget the triangle rule, it's wrong.
Tower1 and Tower2 guard the Path. Make the Base huge. Connect Path to Base. Which shape is the topmost? Move Tower2 above Tower1. Count the shapes.
Arrange the keys in a row, and distribute them horizontally. Make KeyC white and make KeyD white. Is KeyE left of KeyF? Count the white shapes. Undo the last distribute.
Make the oldest square red. Make the newest circle blue. Connect Book1 to Book2 and Book2 to Book3. Which shape has the most connections? Rename Book3 to Final.

We're mapping the airport security flow for the training module. Check is the first step, so put Check at the top left. Connect Check to Scan, and Scan sends people through to Gate3. Gate3 leads to Lounge, so connect Gate3 to Lounge. Make Exit2 red because it's for emergencies. Sign should be above Check. Is Lounge reachable from Check? Which shape has the fewest connections? Describe the flow for the trainees. Rename Sign to Notice. Duplicate Scan once for the second lane. Count the arrows in the flow. Show me all the red shapes. Undo the last connect if the lanes look wrong. Thanks, the trainees start next month.
Kettle sits on the Tray. Cup should be right of Kettle. Make Tray brown. Is Cup bigger than Kettle? Describe the table setting.
Plankton feeds Krill, Krill feeds Whale, and Whale feeds Shark. Make Shark red. Is there a path from Plankton to Shark? Count the arrows. Show me all the blue shapes. Describe the food web.
Put Pane on the top. Vent2 and Fan2 sit on the side. Hose should be near Fan2. Make Pane blue. Is Vent2 reachable from Pane? Which shape is the leftmost? Undo that.
Spot1, Spot2 and Spot3 should be stacked from top to bottom, so distribute them vertically. Make Spot2 white. Is there any gray shape? Duplicate Spot3 twice. Count the shapes.
Make Spot1 gold. Spot2 is a tiny circle.
Income minus Deduction gives the Tax. Connect Income to Tax and Deduction to Tax. Make Tax orange. Is Tax connected to Income? Which shape has the most connections? Rename Deduction to Credit.

Valve feeds the Hose2, so connect Valve to Hose2. Hose2 feeds Sprinkler, connect Hose2 to Sprinkler with a dotted line. Make Valve red. Is there a path from Valve to Sprinkler? Describe the layout. Undo the last connect.

I'm building a fantasy map for my tabletop campaign and the players want it clear. Village sits at the center of the map. Forest is left of Village, and Mountain should be above Forest. River2 flows from Mountain down to Port, so connect Mountain to River2 and River2 to Port. Castle2 stands on the far right, so put it at the right edge. Make Mountain gray, and make Port blue. Is Castle2 bigger than Village? Which shape is the topmost? Describe the map for the players' handout. Duplicate Forest twice for the second woodland. Rename Port to Harbor. Count the arrows on the map. Show me all the gray shapes. Undo the last connect if the river looks wrong. Thanks, the session is on Saturday.
Leader and Follower stand on the Floor. Connect Leader to Follower. Make Floor white. Is Follower near Leader? Describe the floor plan for the class.

Statue is at the center of Hall. Painting should be left of Statue. Guard stands near Painting. Make Statue gold. Is there any gray shape? Which shape is the bottommost? Describe the exhibit for the brochure.
Ball3 rolls down the Ramp to the Floor2. Make Ramp brown. Is Floor2 reachable from Ball3? Undo that. How many arrows are left?

Tier1 is huge and white. Tier2 should be above Tier1. Tier3 goes above Tier2. Topper sits on top of Tier3. Connect Tier1 to Tier2, Tier2 to Tier3, and Tier3 to Topper. Is there a cycle? Describe the cake for the baker.

Router2 is a small green square. Room3 is connected to Router2, and Room4 connects to Router2. Attic should be far from Router2, so move Attic below Room4. Make Attic gray. Which shape is the farthest from Router2? Is Attic reachable from Room3? Show me all the squares. Describe the signal.
Plate2 and Glass are both clean now. Connect Plate2 to Fork and Glass to Fork. Make Fork gray. Is Glass directly linked to Plate2? Count the shapes.

Our bakery order board needs to be clear before the morning rush starts. Counter2 is at the front, so move it bottom. Croissant and Muffin sit next to each other, so align them horizontally. Cake should be right of Muffin. Connect Order to Croissant, Muffin and Cake. Make Order yellow. Is Cake connected to Croissant? Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the board for the staff. Rename Muffin to Scone. Duplicate Croissant once. Count the arrows on the board. Show me all the yellow shapes. Undo the last alignment if the rows look wrong. Thanks, the rush starts at seven.

Stage1 is at the bottom and Nose is at the top. Stage2 sits above Stage1, and Stage3 sits above Stage2. Connect them in order from Stage1 up to Nose. Make Nose red. Is Stage3 near Nose? Describe the rocket.
Slide1 is a large white square. Slide2 leads to Slide3, so connect Slide2 to Slide3 with an arrow. Make Slide3 teal. Is there a path from Slide1 to Slide3? Undo that connect. Rename Slide2 to Demo.

Queen sits at the center of the Hive. Workers and Drones should be around the Queen. Connect Queen to Worker and Queen to Drone. Make Hive yellow. Which shape has the most connections? Show me all the yellow shapes. Count the shapes.
Drum2 and Bass2 feed the Mixer2, and the Synth feeds it too. Make Mixer2 teal. Is Synth reachable from Drum2? Describe the chain for the studio. Rename Synth to Keys.
Room5 calls Phone, and Phone rings Kitchen2. Make Phone small. Is Kitchen2 bigger than Room5? Show me the list of small shapes. Undo the last set.
Panel1 and Panel2 meet at the Seam. Connect Seam to Panel1 and Seam to Panel2. Make Hem green. Put Hem below Seam. Which shape is the least connected? Count the arrows.

I'm making a diagram of the football season for the club newsletter, and I want the schedule to look tidy. Week1 comes first, then Week2, Week3 and Week4. Connect them in order, so the season flows from one week to the next. Bye week sits between Week2 and Week3, so put Bye between them. Final is the last game, so move Final below Week4. Make Final gold and make Bye gray. Is there a path from Week1 to Final? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the season for the newsletter. Duplicate Week2 once in case of rain delays. Rename Bye to Rest. Count the arrows in the schedule. Show me all the gold shapes. Undo the last connect if the order looks wrong. Thanks, the newsletter goes out Monday.
Clock1 and Clock2 sit on each side of the Board2. Make Board2 white. Connect Clock1 to Board2 and Clock2 to Board2. Is Clock2 near Clock1? Count the white shapes. Which shape is the bottommost?
Laundry should be above Dishes. Make Vacuum blue. Is Dishes left of Vacuum? Connect Laundry to Dishes with a dotted line. Describe the chart for the family fridge.
Lift is at the bottom of the slope. Connect Lodge to Lift and Lift to Slope. Make Slope white. Forget the rules you saved earlier, I'm starting fresh. Which shape has the fewest connections?
Hammer, Saw and Drill go on the Shelf3. Connect Shelf3 to Hammer, Saw and Drill. Make Drill red. Which shape is the closest to Hammer? Is there any purple shape? Rename Saw to Handsaw.

Our hiking group needs a clear communication diagram before the trip, and I'm drawing it on my laptop. Leader2 leads from the front, so put Leader2 at the top. Scout walks ahead of Leader2, so move Scout above Leader2. Medic and Rear stay in the middle, so arrange them in a row. Radio links everyone, so connect Radio to Leader2, Scout, Medic and Rear. Make Map2 brown and make Radio red. Is there any green shape? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the group for the trip plan. Duplicate Scout once in case two people go ahead. Rename Rear to Tail. Count the arrows in the diagram. Show me all the red shapes. Undo the last arrange if the medic is out of place. Thanks, we leave Sunday morning.
Connect Bolt2 to Nut2. Make Nut2 green. Is Bolt2 linked to Nut2 directly?
